name: decor-v1
description: Bộ điểm nhấn trang trí nhẹ cho tablet/PC: cành hoa anh đào hai dáng, cụm cánh hoa, băng washi.

jobs.subject: one small slender cherry-blossom sprig lying diagonally, its thin brown twig starting at the lower right and reaching up toward the upper left, with five or six pale pink five-petal sakura flowers, two closed buds and three small fresh green leaves. Delicate, airy and light, lots of empty space between flowers; soft pale pink and blush tones with a little brick-red at the flower centers. Nothing else.

exactly three loose pale pink cherry-blossom petals drifting in a loose diagonal cluster, each petal a different angle and slightly different size, with a tiny notch at the tip of each petal. Soft blush watercolor, very light. Nothing else.
